_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: An AI-powered mobile application designed to help individuals identify food allergens and interpret complex ingredient labels without barcode scanning.
An AI assistant for classrooms to help teachers and students manage learning paths, generate study resources, and track progress.
A health-tech application focusing on cardiac health monitoring, user symptom tracking, and preventative care recommendations.
A crisis response platform connecting victims in emergency situations with nearby NGOs and emergency relief volunteers.
